text:
Alex (PM): Heads-up — annual planning offsite next Thurs. Need to lock facilitation + rooms by EOD Tuesday.
Priya (Eng): +1. Can we confirm objective: product OKRs + launch gating for Q3 features?
Matt (Design): I want a block for customer-story workshops (2x 45m). Need whiteboard space.
Sarah (ProdOps): Room constraints: Main hall booked 9:00–17:00, but we only get AV support for first half day. After lunch it's BYO HDMI/adapters.
Alex (PM): Important: include a 30m session on "scope negotiation roleplay" so PMs and Engs align on must-have vs nice-to-have.
Priya (Eng): For roleplay, can we have a short rubric? Example gates: minimal perf reqs, data privacy ok, rollout capability.
Matt (Design): I can draft a two-column rubric: "Launch musts" / "Stretch opportunities" and a 10-min audience voting step.
Sarah (ProdOps): ops-bot scheduled reminder: "AV test 08:30" will ping #office. ops-bot: AV test scheduled for 2024-11-07 08:30.
Alex (PM): @Sarah, how many breakout rooms? Need 4 groups for cross-functional prioritization exercises.
Sarah (ProdOps): We have 3 small rooms + one huddle; can rebook one smaller to make 4 if we move a monthly all-hands. Doing that now.
Priya (Eng): Can we add an agenda slot to review customer-driven asks we promised this quarter? 20m with decision rule: accept / defer / prototype.
Matt (Design): Add a prep task: each PM brings 1 customer quote + one failing metric that motivated the ask. Keep it concrete.
Alex (PM): Decision rule reminder: adoption threshold + SLO impact + dev effort. If any of the three is a hard no, we defer.
Priya (Eng): For engineering, we need acceptance criteria that include perf budgets. I'll put an example snippet in the shared doc: 
```
- 95p latency <= 250ms for 1k qps
- Memory addition <= 12GB per replica
- No model-change that requires schema migration
```
Matt (Design): Love the concrete criteria. Also propose a 10m "assumption-mapping" warmup: people shout assumptions, we pin them to the canvas.
Alex (PM): Good call. That will make scope negotiation much faster. Who's facilitating the customer-story workshops?
Matt (Design): I can facilitate one, Priya can co-facilitate the other to call out technical constraints.
Sarah (ProdOps): Logistics: catering cut-off is Tuesday noon; dietary form here: https://forms.office/catering.ops.
Alex (PM): Can each facilitator drop a 3-bullet pre-read in the doc by Tues 5pm: objectives, constraints, expected decision.
Priya (Eng): Will do. Also flag: some customers asked for private deployment options — need to surface infra implications in the customer-story session.
Matt (Design): Noted. We'll add a red-tag to stories that need Private/VPC work.
Sarah (ProdOps): AV note: for the afternoon breakout that streams to remote folks, we need a USB mic + camera. I can try to secure it but no promises.
Alex (PM): Backup: record sessions and post transcripts for async reviewers. Also run a quick poll after each prioritization round.
Priya (Eng): Can we define a quick rollout fallback policy in advance? e.g., if perf regresses after canary, auto-roll back to previous model + notify oncall.
Matt (Design): Include a 5-min "launch gating checklist" at the end of each feature slot. I'll sketch UI/UX for the checklist.
Alex (PM): TL;DR action items: (1) Sarah — finalize rooms + AV status by EOD Tue. (2) Matt + Priya — pre-reads and rubric by Tue 5pm. (3) All PMs — bring 1 customer quote + metric. (4) ops-bot — set AV test reminder.
Sarah (ProdOps): On it. I'll post room map and a table of where each group sits.
Priya (Eng): Quick Q: can we get a 15m sync with infra team Wed morning to iron out private deployment flags?
Alex (PM): Yes — I'll book Ira from infra for 09:00 Wed.
Matt (Design): Tiny improv exercise idea for the icebreaker: "If the customer had to explain this feature to a 5-year-old" — 7 mins per table. Helps clarity.
Alex (PM): Cute and useful. Adding to run-of-show.
Priya (Eng): One more: let's embed the launch criteria template in the doc so people can copy/paste during roleplay.
Alex (PM): Agreed. I'll create the template.
Sarah (ProdOps): ops-bot reminder set: "Offsite room/AV final check" Tue 17:00 -> #product.
Alex (PM): Thanks team. If anyone needs to swap roles, ping here. See you all Thurs morning. :party_parrot:
